title: General.
officialText:
Pellet fuel-burning appliances shall be listed and labeled in accordance with ASTM E 1509 and shall be installed
in accordance with the terms of the listing. If permitted, such appliances shall be operated in accordance with the New York City
Air Pollution Control Code.
SECTION MC 905
FIREPLACE STOVES AND ROOM HEATERS
